snippet.title: Cube on a Leash - Steam Next Fest Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Cube on a Leash here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5050630/Cube_on_a_Leash/

The demo for our "what are you playing bro" dungeon crawler roguelike will be available at Steam Next Fest! Stack upgrades and synergies on the Cube while avoiding collateral damage, and manage its automatic and manual behavior to make sure that the enemies are the only ones dying.

Keep up with Eelpunk Studios here:
https://linktr.ee/eelpunkstudios
